label: Stadium / venue
description: A stadium, arena or convention venue: entry gates and sections, ticketing and credentialing, a command post with CCTV, the promoter or tenant team, EMS and police on event day.

vocabulary.facility: the venue (seating bowl, concourses, gates, lots)
vocabulary.frontline: gate supervisors, ushers, ticket-takers, security contractors, concessions managers, medical staff

roles.name: Director of Event Operations (Incident Commander)
roles.description: Owns the event, the building and the staff in it.

roles.name: Director of Security
roles.description: Owns gates, screening, crowd control and the police liaison.

roles.name: Vice President of Communications (PIO)
roles.description: Owns fan messaging, the videoboard, social media and the press.

roles.name: Event Medical Director (EMS Liaison)
roles.description: Owns first-aid stations, EMS and transport.

roles.name: Director of Venue Technology (Technical Lead)
roles.description: Owns ticketing, networks, displays and the investigation.

outsideParties: the transit agency and traffic management
mediaChannels: fan posts on X/Twitter and Instagram with video
the local TV station broadcasting live
the venue's own app and videoboard

sceneAnchors.public: inside a stadium concourse during an event: a dense crowd in team colors, concession counters, dark screens as plain rectangles, bright lighting
sceneAnchors.control: inside a stadium command post: staff in polo shirts watching a wall of dark CCTV monitors, radios on the desk, a window over the seating bowl
sceneAnchors.exterior: outside stadium entry gates: long queues at turnstiles, security staff in high-visibility vests, floodlights, evening

noiseExamples: a concession stand out of change
a suite elevator slow to respond
a lost child at a first-aid station
a vendor truck in the wrong lot
a scanner battery dead at one gate
pressureExamples: a fan video of a crush at a gate going viral
a rumor on X that the game is cancelled
the broadcaster asking for an on-air statement
the promoter refusing to delay the show
